title: From Stages to States: Unified Iterative Reasoning for MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.15620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) substantially enhances the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by explicitly modeling intermediate reasoning processes. However, most learning-based MCoT methods follow a stage-centric paradigm, where different reasoning behaviors are assigned to predefined stages and optimized separately. This results in fragmented reasoning and a training-inference reasoning-state gap. To address these limitations, we propose ReState, a unified iterative reasoning framework that reformulates multimodal reasoning from a stage-driven pipeline into a state-driven dynamic process. It comprises two complementary components: Unified Reasoning State Modeling (URSM) and Closed-Loop Reasoning-State Learning (CRSL). translated_title: 从阶段到状态：面向多模态大语言模型的统一迭代推理
translated_abstract: 多模态思维链（MCoT）通过显式建模中间推理过程，显著增强了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的复杂推理能力。然而，大多数基于学习的MCoT方法遵循以阶段为中心的范式，将不同的推理行为分配到预定义的阶段并分别进行优化。这导致了推理的碎片化以及训练与推理之间的推理状态差距。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了ReState，这是一个统一的迭代推理框架，它将多模态推理从阶段驱动的流水线重新构建为状态驱动的动态过程。该框架包含两个互补的组件：统一推理状态建模（URSM）和闭环推理-状态学习（CRSL）。URSM将推理构建、正确推理的保持以及错误推理的修正统一为共享状态空间内的推理状态转换，使得……
tldr: 提出ReState统一迭代推理框架，将多模态推理从阶段驱动的流水线重构为状态驱动的动态过程，通过统一推理状态建模与闭环推理-状态学习，解决了现有方法推理碎片化和训练-推理状态差距的问题。
en_tdlr: ReState, a unified iterative reasoning framework, reformulates multimodal reasoning from a stage-driven pipeline into a state-driven dynamic process, addressing fragmented reasoning and the training-inference reasoning-state gap through Unified Reasoning State Modeling and Closed-Loop Reasoning-State Learning.
